name: adv_variant_require_satisfied_by_default
source:
// A VARIANT REQUIRE naming a parameter that has a PARAM default must be
// satisfied by the default, not rejected.
COMPONENT Sized(in, out)
  PARAM a, b = 3, model$ = wide
  out.mdot = in.mdot
  out.h    = in.h
  VARIANT wide REQUIRE a, b
    out.P = in.P - a * b
  END
  VARIANT narrow REQUIRE a
    out.P = in.P - a
  END
END
COMPONENT FluidBoundary(out)
  PARAM P, h, mdot
  out.P    = P
  out.h    = h
  out.mdot = mdot
END
FluidBoundary SRC(f1, P = 400000, h = 112929, mdot = 1.0)
Sized         SZ(f1, f2, a = 1000)
Sink          SK(f2)
p2 = f2.P
